title: Compilers, Codecs and Language Toolchains: What Agreement Between Builds Can Establish
description:
Two builds can agree even when neither returns the specified result. This research preprint by Aaron Michael Weis presents a source-linked catalogue of 73 compilers, toolchain entries, formats and codecs. In an exhaustive experiment on one Windows host, two C# compilers at two optimization settings agree on all 256 byte inputs, including a deliberately signed variant that returns the wrong value on 128 inputs. Aaron Michael Weis invites the Colorado Quantum Incubator timing team to help design a trial for the proposed Omega Game Sphere. A repeatable two-player scenario would connect sensor timing with a decision players can see.

Read the versioned PDF. The deposited archive includes the identical PDF, paper text, catalogue, example code, raw observations and component licenses.
